Fixed. Root cause confirmed: present() encoded CopyTextureToBuffer but never submitted it; buffer_map_async does NOT run pending command buffers, so readback was all zeros (dbg_pixels nonzero_bytes=0/256000). FIX (deviation from the proposed linker-shadow interception, which proved non-viable): capture the QueueId in surface-webgpu configure() via the runtime's PUBLIC HostGpuDevice::queue host method (pushes the device's Arc<QueueId> into our ResourceTable; deref to QueueId), store per-instance in WorkloadState, and in present() Global::queue_submit(queue_id,&[cmd_buffer_id]) before buffer_map_async+poll. The linker-shadow approach fails because wasmtime Linker::instance(<versioned path>) is define-only and replaces the whole interface subtree under allow_shadowing, breaking wasi:webgpu's gpu resource registration. ALSO fixed denied_asset_errors: the Component reports a denied load by printing 'not in allowlist' and returning from start() WITHOUT trapping, so run_instance now errors when a run presents ZERO frames (surfacing the Component's diagnostics). PROOF: dbg_pixels corner=(20,13,13,255) clear color, center=mesh, mesh=19705 (30.8%), nonzero=256000/256000; full suite 5/5 green (same_component_hash, renders_shaded_mesh, per_instance_asset_isolation, denied_asset_errors, dbg_pixels). No Component/WIT/browser changes, no runtime fork.
